FLEX.name: Flame Extinguishment Experiment
FLEX.platform: ISS, Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR) / Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus (MDCA)
FLEX.objective: Measure burning and extinction of isolated free-floating fuel droplets to assess gaseous suppressants for spacecraft.
FLEX.approach: Free-floating or tethered droplets ignited in a sealed chamber at controlled O2, pressure and diluent (CO2, He).
FLEX.hardware: MDCA in CIR; droplet deployment needles, hot-wire igniters

key_findings.text: LOI about 0.12 (methanol) and 0.15 (heptane) in O2/N2; about 0.14/0.17 with CO2 dispersed into air; about 0.14/0.15 with He.
Lowering O2 grows the diffusive-extinction diameter and shrinks the radiative-extinction diameter; quasi-steady burning exists between them.
Large heptane droplets continued burning with a cool flame after radiative extinction of the hot flame.

FLEX-2.name: Flame Extinguishment Experiment 2
FLEX-2.objective: Extend FLEX to fuel mixtures, droplet arrays and weak convective flows.
FLEX-2.approach: Single and multiple droplets of pure and blended fuels with and without slow imposed motion.

CFI.name: Cool Flames Investigation
CFI.objective: Study low-temperature (cool-flame) combustion chemistry revealed after hot-flame radiative extinction in microgravity.
CFI.approach: Large n-alkane droplets ignited at conditions favouring radiative extinction and cool-flame transition.

BASS.name: Burning and Suppression of Solids
BASS.objective: Examine flame spread, flammability and suppression of solid materials in low-speed flows.
BASS.approach: Small solid samples (flat sheets, rods, spheres) burned in a flow duct with adjustable air speed; N2 suppression tests.

BASS-II.name: Burning and Suppression of Solids II
BASS-II.objective: Map opposed and concurrent flame spread and flammability limits of solids vs O2 and flow.
BASS-II.approach: PMMA rods/slabs and fabric samples in a duct at reduced O2 and controlled low-speed flow.
BASS-II.hardware: MSG flow duct inside a sealed chamber with O2 control

key_findings.text: Limiting O2 for PMMA rods was lower in microgravity (about 17%) than in normal gravity (about 18%) (value to verify).
Opposed spread rate peaks at intermediate flow; flames are sensitive to flow below about 5 cm/s.

SAME.name: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment (SAME / SAME-R)
SAME.objective: Characterize smoke particle size from overheated spacecraft materials to inform smoke detector design.
SAME.approach: Heat material samples, age the smoke in a chamber for set times, and measure size moments.
SAME.hardware: Smoke generation carousel, aging chamber, particle instruments in MSG

key_findings.text: Average smoke particle sizes mostly fell in the 200-400 nm range (to verify against the SAME-R paper).

Saffire-I-III.name: Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment I-III
Saffire-I-III.platform: Cygnus cargo vehicle after ISS departure
Saffire-I-III.objective: Burn large samples in a spacecraft-scale flow to measure flame growth and flammability at realistic scale.
Saffire-I-III.approach: Large fabric sheet (Saffire I, III) or 9 smaller samples (Saffire II) burned in a flow duct inside Cygnus.

Saffire-IV-VI.name: Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment IV-VI
Saffire-IV-VI.objective: Measure vehicle-level response (pressure, temperature, gas composition) to fires and test detection and cleanup.
Saffire-IV-VI.approach: Multiple samples burned with vehicle sensors recording cabin response; smoke detector and cleanup tests.
Saffire-IV-VI.hardware: Saffire flow unit + combustion product monitors in Cygnus

ACME-BRE.name: ACME Burning Rate Emulator
ACME-BRE.objective: Emulate condensed-fuel burning with a porous gas burner to study flammability without solid-fuel complexity.
ACME-BRE.approach: Gaseous fuel issued through a porous burner; heat flux and flame stability measured vs O2 in still air.
ACME-BRE.hardware: ACME chamber insert with porous burner, heat-flux gauges

key_findings.text: Flames extinguished at 21% O2 within about 40 s; steady flames were observed at 26.5, 34 and 40% O2 (to verify).

ACME-sFlame.name: ACME Structure and Response of Spherical Diffusion Flames (s-Flame)
ACME-sFlame.objective: Study spherical diffusion flames, soot and extinction to test chemical-kinetic models.
ACME-sFlame.approach: Gas issued from a porous sphere into quiescent oxidizer.

ACME-CLD.name: ACME Coflow Laminar Diffusion Flame
ACME-CLD.objective: Measure coflow laminar diffusion flames, soot and lift-off to validate models.
ACME-CLD.approach: Fuel jet with surrounding coflow of oxidizer.

ACME-FlameDesign.name: ACME Flame Design
ACME-FlameDesign.objective: Study soot formation and 'flame design' of spherical flames by varying where inert is added.
ACME-FlameDesign.approach: Spherical gas diffusion flames with inert added to fuel or oxidizer side.

ACME-EFIT.name: ACME Electric-Field Effects on Laminar Diffusion Flames (E-FIT)
ACME-EFIT.objective: Measure the effect of electric fields on flame stability and soot.
ACME-EFIT.approach: Coflow flames with an applied electric field.

SoFIE.name: Solid Fuel Ignition and Extinction
SoFIE.objective: Study ignition, spread and extinction of solid fuels across O2, pressure and flow, including exploration atmospheres.
SoFIE.approach: Solid samples in a flow duct inside the CIR chamber at controlled O2 and pressure.
SoFIE.hardware: SoFIE flow duct insert in CIR

SPICE.name: Smoke Point In Coflow Experiment
SPICE.objective: Measure smoke points of gaseous jet flames in microgravity.
SPICE.approach: Coflow jet flames at varying fuel flow to locate the smoke point.

SLICE.name: Structure and Liftoff In Combustion Experiment
SLICE.objective: Study lift-off and blow-out of laminar jet flames in microgravity.
SLICE.approach: Coflow jet flames with varied coflow and fuel dilution.
